question: What does registration revision 3 specify that the pilot never used?

specified.note: 13 coefficients incl. c0 + deltas + delta-deltas, librosa, 25 ms window / 10 ms hop. Features with no learned structure.

Run in the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29), on the 10,334 sites under joint: best layer 9 on every span, balanced accuracy 0.616–0.625. Ahead of MFCC on every span (C5). Index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position (span grid §8).
Index 0 is the input to the first layer; 1–12 are layer outputs. Pretraining data not yet checked against the paper.

answer:
**Only one item specified in revision 3 was never used by the pilot: the facebook/wav2vec2-base representation, registered with an exploratory role** [rep-wav2vec2].

It was used in other runs, run-rep-communities and run-span-grid [rep-wav2vec2]. In the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29), on the 10,334 sites under the joint condition, it reached its best layer at 9 on every span. Balanced accuracy was 0.616–0.625, ahead of MFCC on every span (C5). Its index 0 is LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), not the CNN output, so it carries position information [rep-wav2vec2].

Every other specified item lists run-pilot among its users:
- the four conditions [cond-joint] [cond-random] [cond-speaker] [cond-word]
- the word-lookup baseline [ctrl-lookup] and the control task [task-control]
- the [ɾ] environment [env-flap]
- the three pooling methods [pool-max] [pool-mean] [pool-midpoint]
- the linear probe [probe-linear]
- the MFCC and WavJEPA representations [rep-mfcc] [rep-wavjepa]
- the speaker-ID and voicing tasks [task-speaker] [task-voicing]

One caveat: the rows don't say whether wav2vec2 was registered before or after the pilot ran. So they don't show whether its absence from the pilot was a deviation from the plan.
